pages.title: Architecture and crate boundaries
pages.purpose: The three-crate workspace split: celld-logic as the sole decision core (on_event), celld as effect executor/adapter host (actor, V8, bucket), celld-ltx as the replication engine. Explain the actor/event mailbox and the no-adapter-mutation invariant.
instructions: Center the page on the on_event / State / Effect isolation pattern and why it exists (fencing monotonicity, deterministic simulation)

pages.title: Cell lifecycle and DO semantics
pages.purpose: Cell states (inactive/resident/active/idle/hibernated), claim vs restore, wake, alarms, cron, queues, sweep/evict, SQLite storage per cell, and where the state machine lives in logic/.
instructions: Ground lifecycle transition semantics in logic/ code and docs/README.md prose; do not speculate beyond what the state machine shows

pages.title: Operational CLI and configuration
pages.purpose: The celld command surface: run/dev/deploy/diagnose/cell/d1/kv/queue/connect/credentials/token, env vars, settings semantics (listen/internal/advertise, storage probe, forwarded headers), output discipline, telemetry/OTLP.
instructions: Explain the stdout-is-data vs stdout-is-log split; document env var conventions via env_vars.rs

pages.title: Deployment pipeline
pages.purpose: celld deploy: wrangler config subset allowlist, esbuild bundling, identity, assets, manifests/pointers in the bucket, generations and rollback; the underlying protocol objects.
instructions: Emphasize the allowlist principle: unknown wrangler config keys are refused, not silently dropped

pages.title: JS runtime and Workers compatibility
pages.purpose: V8 via rusty_v8, one isolate per cell, asyncrt, JS harness/modules and shim APIs (node compat, streams, crypto, websockets), storage ops, host services injection, and the compat boundary to Cloudflare Workers.
instructions: Explain the isolate-per-cell execution model and the JS-async/sync-beneath storage trick; organize the vast topic into subsections

pages.title: Maintenance and change guides
pages.purpose: Focused, source-grounded change guides: add a JS API shim binding, add a config key to the deploy allowlist, change the peer protocol version, add an object-store vendor — each with the files and invariants to respect.
instructions: Each guide must follow the actual file/comment lineage; flag anything where the safe change path is not established by the repo

pages.title: Networking and peer protocol
pages.purpose: Public vs internal listeners, cell routing, peer HTTP + protocol version, HMAC peer auth with clock window and replay protection, peer probe, tunnels, websocket proxying, control plane.
instructions: State the operational contract: internal listener on a trusted private network, no public IP advert, protocol version 5

pages.title: Ownership, leases, and fencing
pages.purpose: How exactly-one-writer is achieved: bucket conditional-write owner records and node leases, expiry, fencing, dead node GC/reconciliation, storage probe, and what the object store must provide.
instructions: Distinguish the decision side (logic::peer, CasGuard/CasOutcome) from the bucket adapter side (ownership_store.rs)
The page must state the qualified-store requirement (conditional create/overwrite, read-after-write) citing docs/guarantees.md

pages.title: Durability and LTX replication
pages.purpose: RPO=0 via LTX: WAL -> LTX capture, single-node bucket round-trip vs multi-node peer forwarding, output gate/pressure, restore/takeover recovery of open logs, compaction, object layout.
instructions: Cover node_log.rs's role too; keep celld-ltx at engine level (from-scratch Litestream v0.5.11 reimplementation, LTX v0.5.2 format)

pages.title: Security boundaries
pages.purpose: Fleet HMAC tokens, credentials/connect actions, what the trusted-network assumption means, the unsafe-public-advertise guard, forwarded headers, and the bucket-credentials-as-admin principle.
instructions: Every claim must trace to docs/security.md or code; flag what is deliberately unsupported rather than inferred

pages.title: Storage backends and credentials
pages.purpose: S3 / GCS / Azure / local-dev object stores, qualified-store requirement, credential chains, storage probe, bucket.rs as adapter, local_store.
instructions: Spell out which services are qualified and which are known-broken or unqualified (per docs/guarantees.md); do not invent others

pages.title: Testing strategy
pages.purpose: Three promises, differential testing against workerd, deterministic simulation of celld-logic, fault injection on live fleets; how to run the suites.
instructions: Ground in docs/testing.md; describe where the simulation/differential harness lives if findable in code

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Get an engineer running celld locally and against a bucket fast: build (cargo), celld dev, deploy, two-node fleet, docker image, pointers to docs. Route to deeper pages.
instructions: Cite concrete files/lines for non-obvious claims; commands must come from README.md or cli.rs, not invented.
